# Method: beginShape()

```ts
beginShape(mode?): void;
```

Start recording vertices for a custom 2D or 3D shape.
Call [vertex](vertex.md) one or more times, then call [endShape](endShape.md) to draw the recorded shape.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `mode?` | [`ShapeAssemblyMode`](../../../enumerations/ShapeAssemblyMode.md) | Shape assembly mode. Defaults to [ShapeAssemblyMode.LINE\_STRIP](../../../enumerations/ShapeAssemblyMode.md#line_strip). |

## Returns

`void`
